summary: Frontend-only test of the Route Comparison panel in /app/frontend/src/components/spot/RightDashboard.jsx. Logged in as admin, opened a new Simple quote tab, entered One-Up W=10 / L=12 / Qty=5000 against the default 200 C Kemi-Lite board, expanded the route-comparison panel and exercised every Switch button (Crest, Reset to Auto, CAD). All 10 acceptance criteria from the review request pass — labels, table layout, verdict/breakeven strings, auto-die, panel collapse, toasts, forced-state confirmation, and Reset to Auto all behave 1:1 with legacy spot_r1_5.jsx.

issues: Winner badge textContent in the DOM is correctly 'CAD wins' / 'Crest wins' / 'Bobst wins' (verified via JS getComputedStyle/textContent), BUT the parent panelHeader applies CSS text-transform:uppercase so the user visually sees 'CAD WINS'. This is consistent across all panel headers in the right dashboard (FREIGHT, ECONOMICS, ROUTE COMPARISON) and matches the legacy spot_r1_5.jsx panel-header treatment, so it is legacy-parity behavior. Flagging as a soft note only: if the PM wants the badge specifically rendered mixed-case while keeping the rest of the header uppercase, the badge span needs an inline style of textTransform:'none'. NOT a functional bug.

action_items: (Optional) Decide whether the winner badge should override panelHeader's text-transform:uppercase so 'CAD wins' renders mixed-case visually. Current behavior is legacy-parity (uppercase) and the DOM text itself is mixed-case as the review request requires.
critical_code_review_comments: RouteComparison component is solid: setManyFields used for atomic patch on Crest/Bobst switch (avoids double engine recompute), useEffect dependency list correctly includes all engine inputs, panel auto-clears stale comp data on tab/input invalidation (L930-935), and the panel correctly hides entirely when CAD or Crest is not viable (L1012) — matching legacy spot_r1_5.jsx L6909.
Die auto-fill logic on Crest switch (L974-977) uses Math.round(comp.crest.die) when dieEstimated is true and falls back to 1200 — correct legacy parity. Bobst switch uses 1800 fallback as spec'd.

Reset-to-Auto does NOT clear the die that was auto-filled by a prior Crest/Bobst switch — this is consistent with legacy (the estimator may want to keep the die value). If product wants it to revert, add a second branch on routeOverride change. Not a bug.

No data-testid issue: route-comparison / route-comparison-toggle / route-winner-badge / route-switch-crest / route-switch-cad / route-switch-bobst / route-switch-auto / route-forced-label are all present and selectable.
seed_data_creation: Created one transient Simple quote tab during testing (auto-saved as SA-260616-165853). No cleanup required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: must use the bottom blue 'Sign in' button, NOT the Microsoft SSO button (the MS SSO endpoint /api/auth/entra/login currently 500s because ENTRA_TENANT_ID env is misconfigured — preview tenant id is set to 'spot-multi-user' which msal rejects; unrelated to the Route Comparison feature). Use JS-side button lookup: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Sign in').click(). Bobst switch is NOT shown for the default B-flute board because Bobst is not viable for C flute — to test the Bobst auto-die $1800 path, switch Item Setup flute to 'E' before entering dims. All other behaviors verified end-to-end.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional issues found. The only observation (badge appears visually uppercase) is rooted in panelHeader CSS text-transform:uppercase which is intentional legacy parity.
